Confirmed again: "no walkable path from Workshop (2,7) to (1,1); in the way: Notice Board at (2,7)." The start tile is blocked.

The body is irrecoverably stuck on the Notice Board tile. Every navigation attempt fails at the start because the engine treats my own tile as blocked. Raw movement in all directions for up to 10 seconds does nothing.

I cannot complete the task. The body spawned embedded in the Notice Board at (2,7) and the game engine will not move it off that blocked tile, so I cannot gather the 3 Wood and 2 Stone, obtain the Gold Key, pass the Gold Door, or reach the workbench to craft the Crown.

I'm stuck: my body is embedded in the Notice Board at (2,7) and the engine refuses to move it off that blocked tile, so I cannot gather materials or reach the workbench to craft the Crown.
